neighbours.label: an imperative verb in practical advice ('put everything in a bag', 'sit less')
fire: Trust nobody; keep everything in a dry bag.
The advice is to wake early, eat less, and walk more.
Don't wait for rain; pack everything in a sealed box.
Before you call the bank, check your last statement.
The rule is to slow down, look twice, and turn left.
Don't lose hope; write everything down in a notebook.
Before you leave the house, lock the back door.
The lesson is to speak up, listen more, and stay calm.
